description: This file defines the singleton class ThingCommandStrategies, which extends AbstractCommandStrategies and manages various command strategies related to handling 'Thing' objects in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to retrieve specific command strategies for creating, modifying, retrieving, and deleting things, along with related entities like policies, ACLs, attributes, definitions, features, and security (Sudo).

classes.name: ThingCommandStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that aggregates various command strategies for processing 'Thing' related commands in a persistent actor framework.

methods.name: ThingCommandStrategies
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the strategy collections for different aspects of 'Thing' management.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingCommandStrategies.

methods.name: getCreateThingStrategy
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton CreateThingStrategy used for creating 'Thing' objects.

methods.name: addThingStrategies
methods.description: Internal method to add core 'Thing' manipulation strategies.

methods.name: addPolicyStrategies
methods.description: Adds strategies for handling policies related to 'Thing'.

methods.name: addAclStrategies
methods.description: Adds strategies for handling Access Control Lists associated with 'Thing'.

methods.name: getEmptyResult
methods.description: Returns an empty Result object for 'ThingEvent' types.
